Entry Wine, Mead, and Ale What you drink can often reveal a person's origins more than what you say. The wine of the Reach, the ale of the North, and the strong liquor of the Iron Islands each have their own temperament; the host of the banquet uses wine to entertain guests, the soldier uses wine to strengthen his courage, and the poor sometimes can only forget with the light wine like muddy water.
